latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Instantly turn up to 3 product photos or a single promo image into a 1080p animated video for free.
- Simple workflow: upload images, describe desired video, and receive an MP4 in 20–40 seconds.
- No accounts required; free starter tokens provided with 100 credits for 7 days.
- Supports quick edits, batch processing, and iterative video refinement.
- Wide range of supported formats: mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac.
- User-friendly error handling and guidance throughout the video creation process.
